newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VINGIS TO START NEW SHARE SUBSCRIPTION.
newsitem.headline: VINGIS TO START NEW SHARE SUBSCRIPTION.

text.p: Lithuania's electronic components producer Vilniaus Vingis said on Tuesday that it will begin the subscription of its 13.82 million litas share issue on Wednesday.

The company said in an add in the daily Lietuvos rytas that the subscription is 35 days and the current shareholders have a priority right to buy proportionally into the new issue for the next 30 days.
The securities commission on Friday registered 2,764,000 ordinary shares of Vilniaus Vingis with a face value of five litas.
"The issue price will be 5.8 litas," technical director Rimvydas Savickas told Reuters.
The shares of Vilniaus Vingis were quoted at 5.11 litas on the Vilnius bourse on Monday.
The share capital of the company after the boost will stand at 45.62 million litas.
The company said earlier it was planning to use 75 percent of the funds raised by the issue for investments in new technologies and 25 percent would be used for turnover funds.
The company is listed on the group A of the Vilnius bourse.
The state has a 33.5 percent stake in the company.
